name: FFS_QBI_CAR_TREE_NODE
description: Stores all the CAR tree nodes (CARs, sub-CAR, and groups).

columns.name: NODE_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies capacity area tree node.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Reference to parent node identifier. Zero value means that this node is located on the top level of hierarchy.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type description of this node. It can be 'group', 'area' and 'sub-area'.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of this node. By default, inactive items are not shown on the Quota screen.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of this node defined by customer.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique label ; The 'unique' constraint is applied to: (1) all capacity areas (regardless status), (2) all capacity sub-areas (regardless status), (3) all capacity area groups (regardless status). The constraint is case-insensitive.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to RESOURCE_ID in FFS_RESOURCE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
